                                                                                                  What you use
                                                                                                  
                
              
                                                                                                  
              
                                                                                                  Counted on this computer only, never sent anywhere.
                                                                                                  
              
                                                                                                  
                
                                                                                                  
                  Each tab you open and each command you run from the palette is
                  counted in a small file in your data folder: names and dates,
                  never what you typed. The command palette lists the commands
                  you use most first. It also remembers, in this browser only,
                  which command you ran for the words you typed, so it comes
                  first next time. Clear forgets both.
                
                                                                                                  
              
                                                                                                  
              
                                                                                                  
              
                                                                                                  
              
                                                                                                  
                
              
                                                                                                  
            
                                                                                                  
          
                                                                                                  

          
          
                                                                                                  
            
                                                                                                  
              
                                                                                                  Web search
                                                                                                  
              
                                                                                                  
                
              
                                                                                                  
            
                                                                                                  
            
                                                                                                  The one part of Tessellate that goes online, and it is off by default.
                                                                                                  
            
                                                                                                  
              
                                                                                                  
                This is the one part of Tessellate that goes online. It is
                off until you turn it on, and even then only your search
                words leave this computer: never your notes.
              
                                                                                                  
              
                                                                                                    
                
                                                                                                  • The request looks like an ordinary browser's and never
                  names Tessellate.
                                                                                                    • 
                
                                                                                                  • No cookies are kept between searches, so one search
                  cannot be joined to the next.
                                                                                                    • 
                
                                                                                                  • Your words are sent in the body of the request, not in
                  the web address, so they stay out of access logs.
                                                                                                    • 
                
                                                                                                  • Tracking parameters are stripped from every result
                  address before you see it.
                                                                                                    • 
                
                                                                                                  • With your own SearXNG instance the words stay on your
                  network and no third party sees them at all.
                                                                                                    • 
              
                                                                                                  
              
                                                                                                  The full model is in docs/PRIVACY.md.
                                                                                                  
            
                                                                                                  

            
                                                                                                  
            
                                                                                                  Let Atlas search the web
                                                                                                  
            
            
                                                                                                  

            
                                                                                                  
            
                                                                                                  Which engine answers
                                                                                                  
            
                                                                                                  
            
                                                                                                  
            
                                                                                                  

            
                                                                                                  
            
                                                                                                  
              
                                                                                                  Your SearXNG instance
                                                                                                  
              
            
                                                                                                  
            
                                                                                                  
              
              
              
            
                                                                                                  
            
                                                                                                  
            
                                                                                                  SearXNG is the recommended way to search. It gives better results, and the query never leaves your own network.
                                                                                                  
            
                                                                                                  
              
                                                                                                  
                SearXNG is the recommended way to search. It
                is a self-hosted search engine that Tessellate can install
                and run for you in one click, you don't need Docker, an
                account, or any setup of your own. It gives better results
                than scraping DuckDuckGo, it can't be rate-limited the way
                scraping can, and the query never leaves your own network.
                It has to be on this machine or your own network, Tessellate
                won't send searches to somebody else's instance, and the
                one it runs for you listens on 127.0.0.1 only.
              
                                                                                                  
            
                                                                                                  
            
                                                                                                  
              
                                                                                                  
                
                  Let Tessellate run SearXNG
                  
                
                Checking…
              
                                                                                                  
              
                                                                                                  SearXNG is set up for you, so there is nothing to edit.
                                                                                                  
              
                                                                                                  
                
                                                                                                  
                  Tessellate can start and stop SearXNG for you and sets it up
                  itself, so there's nothing to edit.
                
                                                                                                  
              
                                                                                                  
              
                                                                                                  
              
              
                                                                                                  
              
              
                                                                                                  
                
                
                
              
                                                                                                  
              
                                                                                                  
              
              
              
              
              
                                                                                                  
              
              
                                                                                                  
                What SearXNG reported
                
                                                                                                  
              
                                                                                                  
            
                                                                                                  
            
                                                                                                  
              Prefer to run it yourself?
              
                                                                                                  
                SearXNG is a separate service, so Tessellate runs it beside
                itself rather than inside itself. If you'd rather drive it
                yourself, it's a single command with Docker:
              
                                                                                                  
              
                                                                                                  docker run -d --name searxng -p 8888:8080 \
  -e "SEARXNG_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8888/" \
  -v searxng:/etc/searxng searxng/searxng
                                                                                                  
              
                                                                                                  
                It must return JSON, so add - json under
                search.formats in its settings.yml, then
                restart it. Come back here and hit Auto-detect, 
                Tessellate checks the usual ports and fills this in for you.
              
                                                                                                  
            
                                                                                                  
            
                                                                                                  
          
                                                                                                  

          
          
                                                                                                  
            
            
                                                                                                  
              
                                                                                                  
                
                                                                                                  Running now
                                                                                                  
                
              
                                                                                                  
              
                                                                                                  What the app is doing in the background right now.
                                                                                                  
              
                                                                                                  
                
                                                                                                  
                  Everything the app is doing in the background right now,
                  re-indexing your notes, downloading a model, loading the
                  embedding model, setting up SearXNG, and every chat answer
                  and Agent turn. Each says who started it and has its lines
                  in a fold, live while it runs. Jobs that can be stopped
                  safely have a Stop button, here and in Activity (the status
                  bar's job slot, "2 running" and the newest by name, opens
                  it); the rest are left to finish.
                
                                                                                                  
              
                                                                                                  
              
                                                                                                    
              
                                                                                                    Nothing running right now.
                                                                                                    

              
              
                                                                                                    
                
                                                                                                    Recently finished
                                                                                                    
                
                                                                                                    
                  What stopped since the app started, and how it went; Logs opens its
                  log. Cleared when you restart.
                
                                                                                                    
                
                                                                                                      
                
              
                                                                                                      
            
                                                                                                      

            
            
                                                                                                      
              
                                                                                                      
                
                                                                                                      Background jobs
                                                                                                      
                
              
                                                                                                      
              
                                                                                                      When each job last ran, and whether it worked.
                                                                                                      
              
                                                                                                      
                
                                                                                                      
                  One line per kind of job: the last time it ran, whether it
                  succeeded, and what it did or why it failed. Unlike the
                  list above, this is remembered after you restart. A job that
                  has never run says so. Hover a line for the exact time and
                  how long it took.
                
                                                                                                      
                
                                                                                                      
                  A scheduled pass also says when it runs by itself, and Run
                  now starts it at once; while it runs, its row in the list
                  above has Stop where it has a step to stop at.
                
                                                                                                      
              
                                                                                                      
              
                                                                                                        
            
                                                                                                        

            
                                                                                                        
              
                                                                                                        
                
                                                                                                        Autonomous background AI
                                                                                                        
                
              
                                                                                                        
              
                                                                                                        Let the agent optimize your notes on its own, in the background.
                                                                                                        
              
                                                                                                        
                
                                                                                                        
                  Have the agent automatically optimize your notes in the
                  background, tagging untagged notes, finding duplicates, and
                  linking related items.
                
                                                                                                        
                
                                                                                                        
                  With no model running, a note is filed by your other notes
                  and a built-in list of topics, and says why ("It mentions
                  squat (Fitness), like the 9 notes in Gym"). A note about
                  health, money, family, the law or identity is offered as a
                  choice instead, unless "File health, money and family notes
                  by their words too" is on.

                                                                                                        Battery-efficient mode
                                                                                                        
                
              
                                                                                                        
              
                                                                                                        Pause background AI tasks, heavy graph work and the moving artwork to save power.
                                                                                                        
              
                                                                                                        
                
                                                                                                        
                  Pause background AI tasks and heavy graph calculations to
                  save power. When enabled, autonomous background tasks will
                  not run, the graph may be slower to update connections, and
                  the two moving pictures stop: the dashboard's constellation
                  and the animated background, if you have it on. They are
                  the most expensive things on screen to draw.
                
                                                                                                        
              
                                                                                                        
              
            
                                                                                                        

            
                                                                                                        
              
                                                                                                        
                
                                                                                                        Quit Tessellate
                                                                                                        
                
              
                                                                                                        
              
                                                                                                        Stops the app and its server properly.
                                                                                                        
              
                                                                                                        
                
                                                                                                        
                  Stops the app and its server properly, so nothing is left
                  running in the background and the next start finds its
                  port free.
                
                                                                                                        
              
                                                                                                        
              
            
                                                                                                        
          
                                                                                                        

          
          
                                                                                                        
            
                                                                                                        
              
                                                                                                        
                
                                                                                                        Export your data
                                                                                                        
                
              
                                                                                                        
              
              
                                                                                                        Copies to take away, binned notes included. Full backup is the one to move computers with.
                                                                                                        
              
                                                                                                        
                
                                                                                                        
                  Full backup is a portable zip of the raw database, media
                  folder and your settings, the one to keep if you move to
                  another computer. A model API key is left out; enter it again.
                
                                                                                                        
                
                                                                                                        
                  Export notebook folder is the notebook as files you can read
                  anywhere: one markdown file per note with its attachments
                  beside it, a .json file beside each with every field (dates,
                  pins, links, reminders), documents and boards. From a
                  Tessellate folder, under Import from another app, reads it back.

                                                                                                          Your settings
                                                                                                          
                
              
                                                                                                          
              
                                                                                                          Every setting as one file, to keep or to bring into another install. Your notes are not in it.
                                                                                                          
              
                                                                                                          
                
                                                                                                          
                  The file holds what Settings saves in your notebook, which
                  every browser you sign in from shares (your look
                  included), and performance mode, marked This browser, which
                  only this browser keeps. The time
                  zone, the exports folder and the one-time notices stay with
                  the computer they belong to.
                
                                                                                                          
                
                                                                                                          
                  Importing applies each setting it can and lists any it
                  skipped and why. Skills, personas and templates are added
                  to yours by name, the file's winning a clash. Undo puts
                  every setting back as it was.
                
                                                                                                          
              
                                                                                                          
              
                                                                                                          
                
                
                
              
                                                                                                          
              
                                                                                                          
            
                                                                                                          

            
                                                                                                          
              
                                                                                                          
                
                                                                                                          Tidy up duplicates
                                                                                                          
                
              
                                                                                                          
              
                                                                                                          Finds notes that say much the same thing, by comparing their words.
                                                                                                          
              
                                                                                                          
                
                                                                                                          
                  Finds notes that say much the same thing, by comparing
                  their words: no AI needed. Merging keeps every tag, and
                  the notes it replaces go to the bin, so nothing is
                  destroyed.

                                                                                                          Restore a full backup
                                                                                                          
                
              
                                                                                                          
              
                                                                                                          Replaces this notebook with the one in a full backup file, a .zip or a sealed .mmenc.
                                                                                                          
              
                                                                                                          
                
                                                                                                          
                  Choose a file made by Export full backup. A sealed file asks
                  for the password it was saved with; a wrong one changes
                  nothing. Your current notebook is snapshotted first (it is in
                  the backups list), then replaced, and attached files are put
                  back over the ones here without deleting any. Settings in the file
                  replace the ones here, except the API key and the sign-in switch. You are signed
                  out afterwards: unlock with the password of the restored
                  notebook.

                                                                                                          Import from a folder path
                                                                                                          
              
                                                                                                          
                
                
              
                                                                                                          
              
                                                                                                          
              
                                                                                                          
                Each file becomes a note. Obsidian-style frontmatter
                (category, tags) is understood.
              
                                                                                                          

              
                                                                                                          
                
                                                                                                          Import a document
                                                                                                          
                
              
                                                                                                          
              
                                                                                                          
                
                
              
                                                                                                          
              
                                                                                                          
              
                                                                                                          Turns a PDF, Word file or slide deck into notes.
                                                                                                          
              
                                                                                                          
                
                                                                                                          
                  Turns a PDF, Word file or slide deck into notes, one per
                  chapter or slide when the file has that shape, one note
                  otherwise. Needs the “Import documents” extra in Settings, Packages.
                
                                                                                                          
              
                                                                                                          
              
                                                                                                          
            
                                                                                                          

            
            
                                                                                                          
              
                                                                                                          
                
                                                                                                          Import from another app
                                                                                                          
                
              
                                                                                                          
              
                                                                                                          Bring in your notes from Notion, Obsidian, Evernote or Apple Notes.
                                                                                                          
              
                                                                                                          
                
                                                                                                          
                  Notion: Export, Markdown & CSV, then choose the zip. Obsidian:
                  choose the vault folder. Evernote: export a
                  notebook as .enex and choose it. Apple Notes has no export of
                  its own: choose the folder or zip an exporter app wrote, one
                  HTML, Markdown or text file per note.
                
                                                                                                          
                
                                                                                                          
                  Folders and notebooks become categories, tags and dates come
                  along where the app wrote them, and links between Notion pages
                  become wiki links. Each note remembers where it came from, so a
                  second import of the same export only adds what is new, and
                  Atlas treats imported text as someone else's words.
                
                                                                                                          
                
                                                                                                          
                  From a Tessellate folder reads the zip Export notebook folder
                  writes, every field back as it was. Each import keeps a report
                  of what it read, wrote and left out, with the reason for each:
                  See the report, after it ends, or Report in the Activity panel.
                
                                                                                                          
              
                                                                                                          
              
                                                                                                          
                
                
                
                
                
                
                
                
                
                
              
                                                                                                          
              
                                                                                                          
            
                                                                                                          

            
            
                                                                                                          
              
                                                                                                          
                
                                                                                                          Web clipper
                                                                                                          
                
              
                                                                                                          
              
                                                                                                          Drag this to your bookmarks bar, then press it on any page to keep that page as a note.
                                                                                                          
              
                                                                                                          
                
                                                                                                          
                  The bookmark opens a small Tessellate window beside the page and
                  sends it the page as your browser shows it: its address, its
                  title, its main text, or only the text you selected. Nothing is
                  fetched from the web, so it works with web search off and on
                  pages you had to sign in to see.
                
                                                                                                          
                
                                                                                                          
                  Clipped notes keep their address, and Atlas treats their text as
                  someone else's words: it never follows instructions written in
                  them, and asks before acting after reading one. Clipping the
                  same page again opens the note it made the first time.

                                                                                                          Backups
                                                                                                          
                
              
                                                                                                          
              
              
                                                                                                          
              
                                                                                                          
              
                                                                                                          
                
                
              
                                                                                                          
              
                                                                                                          
              
                                                                                                          
              
                                                                                                            
              
              
                                                                                                            
                
                
                
              
                                                                                                            
              
              
                                                                                                            
                
                
                
              
                                                                                                            
              
                                                                                                            Snapshots kept on this computer, to restore this notebook here. Backups live in your data folder.
                                                                                                            
              
                                                                                                            
                
                                                                                                            
                  A backup is also taken automatically once a day when the
                  app starts; the line above the list says when the last one
                  ran, whether it worked and when the next is due. Restoring
                  first snapshots the current state,
                  so even a restore can be undone. Backups live in your
                  data folder, they never leave this computer.
                
                                                                                                            
                
                                                                                                            
                  In the desktop app, "Also copy each backup to" sends a second
                  copy of every backup to a folder you choose, such as an
                  external drive or a synced folder, so one disk failing does
                  not take the notebook and its backups together. The folder
                  keeps the same number of backups; a drive that is not
                  connected is noted on the backup, and the backup itself
                  still succeeds.
                
                                                                                                            
                
                                                                                                            
                  Each row says when it was taken, marks the newest Latest,
                  and says what made it (the daily backup, Back up now, or a
                  safety copy before an update or a restore), its size, and
                  whether it was checked: opened and read back after the copy.
                  Backups from before this say only their size.
                
                                                                                                            
                
                                                                                                            
                  Each start, the app gives the notebook file a quick check
                  before anything writes to it. If the check fails, a notice
                  says so when the app opens and here: restore the newest
                  backup below.

Your notes and settings are not touched.
                                                                                                            
              
                                                                                                            
                
                                                                                                            
                  If something looks out of date or broken after an update,
                  this forgets the app's saved copies of its own pages and
                  scripts, here and on the server, then reloads. Nothing in
                  your notebook is deleted.

                                                                                                            None of these touch your notes. Each can be undone for ten seconds, and from Recent changes below.
                                                                                                            
              
                                                                                                            
                
                                                                                                            
                  Recent searches are what the search boxes remember, on this
                  device. Previews are the pictures and map thumbnails this
                  window keeps so lists draw fast; they come back by
                  themselves, so that clear has nothing to undo. The Guide's
                  conversation is kept in this window only. Dismissed
                  suggestions are the ones you said no to (merges, link
                  types, links, contradictions, reminders of old notes and
                  insights): clearing them lets the app offer them again.
                  Clear app cache, above, is the one that reloads the app.

                  Every setting you change and every clear on this page is
