                                                                                                              Account & security
                                                                                                              
              
                                                                                                              
                
              
                                                                                                              
            
                                                                                                              
            
                                                                                                              Tessellate is a single-user app: one notebook, one password.
                                                                                                              
            
                                                                                                              
              
                                                                                                              
                Tessellate is a single-user app: one
                notebook, one password, all on this machine. To keep
                separate notebooks, run the app with a different data
                folder rather than a second account.
              
                                                                                                              
            
                                                                                                              

            
                                                                                                              
              
                                                                                                              This notebook
                                                                                                              
              
                                                                                                                
            
                                                                                                                

            
                                                                                                                
              
                                                                                                                
                
                                                                                                                Signing in
                                                                                                                
                
              
                                                                                                                
              
                                                                                                                
                
                                                                                                                
                  Turned off, the app opens on this computer without asking.
                  Another device on your network still needs the password,
                  and so do private notes: they stay encrypted and ask for it
                  when you open one. Turning it off asks for your current
                  password.
                
                                                                                                                
              
                                                                                                                
              
            
                                                                                                                

            
            
                                                                                                                
              
                                                                                                                
                
                                                                                                                Other devices
                                                                                                                
                
              
                                                                                                                
              
                                                                                                                
                
                                                                                                                
                  Off, only this computer can open the app: nothing on your
                  network can even reach it. On, a phone or another computer
                  on the same network can open it at the address shown here,
                  and always has to give your password, whatever this
                  computer is set to. Private notes still ask for it too.
                  Nothing installs on the phone: it is a browser window onto
                  this computer, where search, the models and the notes run.
                
                                                                                                                
                
                                                                                                                
                  Traffic on your network is encrypted (https, on its own
                  port, 8443 beside the usual 8000). The certificate is made
                  on this computer rather than bought from a company browsers
                  already trust, so the first time a device opens the address
                  it warns that the connection is not private.
                
                                                                                                                
                
                                                                                                                
                  Before you continue past that warning, open the
                  certificate's details on the other device and compare its
                  SHA-256 fingerprint with the one shown here. If they match,
                  continue, and that device will not ask again. If they do
                  not, stop: something else is answering at that address.
                  Regenerate certificate makes a new one, for example after
                  this computer's address changes; every device then warns
                  once more.
                
                                                                                                                
                
                                                                                                                
                  The change takes effect at once: turning it off signs every
                  other device out. Turning it on asks for your current
                  password, and resetting the password turns it off. Unused
                  for 14 days, it turns itself off and says so here.
                
                                                                                                                
                
                                                                                                                
                  The wifi icon in the status bar (Alt+L) shows the same at a
                  glance: open, closed on this network, or off. Its panel has
                  the switch, the address, and the networks: trusted ones with
                  Stop trusting and Forget, and the ones it stayed closed on
                  with Trust and Forget. Each new network the app sees is
                  listed there untrusted until you choose.
                
                                                                                                                
                
                                                                                                                
                  On a network you have not allowed, such as a cafe or an
                  airport, nothing can reach the notebook: turning this on
                  remembers the network you are on (by its router, read on
                  this computer), and anywhere else Settings and the bell
                  offer Allow on this network. A network Windows calls public
                  always asks. Allow on any network stops asking.
                
                                                                                                                
                
                                                                                                                
                  The first time a phone or computer signs in, it waits until
                  you choose Allow on this computer; allowed devices are
                  listed here with Remove, which also signs them out. Devices
                  outside your own network (a forwarded port) are never let
                  in. Loosening any of these asks for your password.
                
                                                                                                                
                
                                                                                                                
                  On Windows, if a phone connects once and then stops, the
                  firewall is blocking the port. The line shown below the
                  address opens it on private networks only; run it in a
                  Command Prompt opened as administrator.
                
                                                                                                                
              
                                                                                                                
              
              
                                                                                                                
              
              
                                                                                                                
                
                                                                                                                
                
                                                                                                                
                  
                
                                                                                                                
              
                                                                                                                
              
              
                                                                                                                
              
              
                                                                                                                
                
                                                                                                                If a phone cannot connect, Windows may be blocking it. Paste this into a Command Prompt opened as administrator. It opens the port on private networks only.
                                                                                                                
                
                                                                                                                
                
                                                                                                                
                  
                
                                                                                                                
              
                                                                                                                
              
                                                                                                                
                
                
                
                                                                                                                
                  
                                                                                                                Waiting to sign in
                                                                                                                
                  
                                                                                                                  
                
                                                                                                                  
                
                                                                                                                  Allowed devices
                                                                                                                  
                
                                                                                                                    
                
                                                                                                                    Trusted networks
                                                                                                                    
                
                                                                                                                      
                
                
                                                                                                                      
                  
                                                                                                                      Untrusted networks
                                                                                                                      
                  
                                                                                                                        
                
                                                                                                                        
              
                                                                                                                        
              
              
              
                                                                                                                        
                
                                                                                                                        Certificate fingerprint (SHA-256), to compare with the warning on the other device:
                                                                                                                        
                
                                                                                                                        
                
                                                                                                                        
                
                                                                                                                        
                
                                                                                                                        Authority fingerprint, shown when the phone installs it:
                                                                                                                        
                
                                                                                                                        
                
                                                                                                                        
                  
                  
                  
                
                                                                                                                        
                
                                                                                                                        
                  
                                                                                                                        
                    Open this page on the phone, sign in, and press Trust this
                    certificate on your phone to download the certificate.
                  
                                                                                                                        
                  
                                                                                                                        
                    iPhone: open the address in Safari, press Install the
                    certificate on the lock screen (or the button here once
                    signed in), and choose Allow. Then, in the iPhone's own Settings
                    app, General, VPN and Device Management, Tessellate,
                    Install. Then General, About, Certificate Trust Settings,
                    and switch the certificate on for full trust.
                  
                                                                                                                        
                  
                                                                                                                        
                    Android: in the phone's own settings, open Security, then
                    Encryption and credentials, Install a certificate, CA
                    certificate, and pick the file.
                  
                                                                                                                        
                  
                                                                                                                        
                    The file is a small certificate authority made on this
                    computer, which can only vouch for addresses on your own
                    network. When this computer's address changes, the app
                    makes a new certificate under the same authority, so a
                    phone that trusts it is not asked again.
                  
                                                                                                                        
                  
                                                                                                                        
                    If the phone cannot connect at all, check that both are on
                    the same Wi-Fi (a guest network keeps devices apart), that
                    the address starts with https, and that this computer's
                    firewall lets the app in: Windows asks once, so choose
                    Private networks.
                  
                                                                                                                        
                  
                                                                                                                        
                    A phone's hotspot works too: join this computer to it, and
                    the app makes a certificate for the new address at once,
                    under the same authority. Bluetooth only carries a hotspot;
                    the app is a web page and cannot use it directly.
                  
                                                                                                                        
                
                                                                                                                        
              
                                                                                                                        
            
                                                                                                                        

            
                                                                                                                        
              
                                                                                                                        
                
                                                                                                                        Change your password
                                                                                                                        
                
              
                                                                                                                        
              
                                                                                                                        Private notes move across to the new password automatically.
                                                                                                                        
              
                                                                                                                        
                
                                                                                                                        
                  Your current password is asked for even though you're
                  already unlocked: being at an unlocked screen isn't proof
                  of knowing it. Private notes move across to the new
                  password automatically.
                
                                                                                                                        
              
                                                                                                                        
              
              
              
              
              
              
              
                                                                                                                        
                
                
              
                                                                                                                        
            
                                                                                                                        

            
            
                                                                                                                        
              
                                                                                                                        
                
                                                                                                                        PIN for this computer
                                                                                                                        
                
              
                                                                                                                        
              
                                                                                                                        Unlock on this computer with a few digits instead of your password.
                                                                                                                        
              
                                                                                                                        
                
                                                                                                                        
                  A PIN of 4 to 12 digits unlocks the app on this computer
                  only, like Windows Hello. Phones and other devices always
                  need your password, and so do changing the password,
                  changing or forgetting the PIN, and letting other devices in.
                
                                                                                                                        
                
                                                                                                                        
                  The PIN is kept by this computer's own protected store
                  (Windows, the macOS Keychain, or the Linux keyring), never
                  in your notebook or its backups, so a copied notebook is no
                  easier to open. Five wrong PINs remove it. Changing your
                  password or re-encrypting private notes removes it too.
                
                                                                                                                        
              
                                                                                                                        
              
                                                                                                                        
                
                
                
                
              
                                                                                                                        
              
                                                                                                                        
                
                
                
              
                                                                                                                        
            
                                                                                                                        

            
            
                                                                                                                        
              
                                                                                                                        
                
                                                                                                                        Re-encrypt private notes
                                                                                                                        
                
              
                                                                                                                        
              
                                                                                                                        A new key for every private note, so an old backup or copy can't open today's.
                                                                                                                        
              
                                                                                                                        
                
                                                                                                                        
                  Changing your password keeps the key that encrypts private
                  notes and only re-locks it. If a backup or a copy of the
                  notebook may have reached someone, re-encrypting gives every
                  private note a new key, so what they have no longer opens
                  them. It is all or nothing: a note that fails leaves every
                  note as it was. Private notes a password reset sealed stay
                  as they are, since no key here opens them. A recovery key,
                  if you made one, is replaced and the new one shown once.
                
                                                                                                                        
              
                                                                                                                        
              
                                                                                                                        
                
                
              
                                                                                                                        
            
                                                                                                                        

            
                                                                                                                        
              
                                                                                                                        
                
                                                                                                                        Sessions
                                                                                                                        
                
              
                                                                                                                        
              
                                                                                                                        Changing your password ends every other session.
                                                                                                                        
              
                                                                                                                        
                
                                                                                                                        
                  Unlocking issues a token that lives in memory only, so
                  restarting the app locks it again. Changing your password
                  ends every other session.
                
                                                                                                                        
              
                                                                                                                        

              
              

              
                                                                                                                        
                
              
                                                                                                                        
            
                                                                                                                        

            
            
                                                                                                                        
              
                                                                                                                        
                
                                                                                                                        Recovery key
                                                                                                                        
                
              
                                                                                                                        
              
                                                                                                                        Sets a new password if you forget yours, with private notes kept.
                                                                                                                        
              
                                                                                                                        
                
                                                                                                                        
                  A recovery key is a second way to open your private notes,
                  shown once for you to keep somewhere away from this
                  computer. "Forgot your password?" on the lock screen takes
                  it and a new password. The app never stores the key, only
                  a copy of the encryption key locked with it.
                
                                                                                                                        
                
                                                                                                                        
                  Replacing it asks for your current password, and the old
                  key stops working. Using it, or re-encrypting private
                  notes, also hands you a new one.
                
                                                                                                                        
              
                                                                                                                        
              
                                                                                                                        
                
                
              
                                                                                                                        
            
                                                                                                                        

            
                                                                                                                        
              
                                                                                                                        
                
                                                                                                                        If you forget your password
                                                                                                                        
                
              
                                                                                                                        
              
                                                                                                                        Use "Forgot your password?" on the lock screen, on this computer.
                                                                                                                        
              
                                                                                                                        
                
                                                                                                                        
                  With your recovery key you set a new password and keep
                  every private note. Without it, a reset clears the password
                  so you can set a new one: ordinary notes,
                  documents, boards and settings are not encrypted and are
                  kept; private notes stay sealed for good,
                  because only your password or the recovery key opens them.
                  A sealed backup still opens with its own password.
                
                                                                                                                        
                
                                                                                                                        
                  Both work only on the computer the notebook lives on. The
                  reset also turns off "Allow other devices on this network",
                  so the notebook is never open to your network without a
                  password. The same reset runs in a terminal:
                
                                                                                                                        
                
                                                                                                                        python -m tessellate --reset-password
                                                                                                                        
              
                                                                                                                        
            
                                                                                                                        
          
                                                                                                                        

          
          
                                                                                                                        
            
                                                                                                                        
              
                                                                                                                        Where your data went
                                                                                                                        
              
                                                                                                                        
                
              
                                                                                                                        
            
                                                                                                                        
            
                                                                                                                        Every connection this app made, recorded as it happened.
                                                                                                                        
            
                                                                                                                        
              
                                                                                                                        
                The interpreter itself reports every connection and every name
                lookup this app makes, whatever part of it asks, so nothing can
                leave without appearing here.
              
                                                                                                                        
              
                                                                                                                        
                Each place is one row: what it was for, in words (the file
                downloaded, the search words, the update checked), which
                feature reached it, and how often. Its exact addresses are
                under Addresses.
              
                                                                                                                        
              
                                                                                                                        
                The Local chip in the top bar shows this launch's verdict in
                one word and opens this page.

                                                                                                                            The app's own log, updating live. Filter the records by text, switch between a list and a terminal view, and use the three dots to narrow by which log and how serious. Support bundle saves a zip of the log, your settings and the app's status, for a bug report. To send us what is slow or broken, open the three dots and press Copy diagnostics: one plain-text report (lag, errors, slow routes, how big your notebook is, no note text) to paste into a message, or Save diagnostics as file.

                                                                                                                                 Ask Atlas
                                                                                                                                
                  
                
                                                                                                                                
                
              
                                                                                                                                
              
                                                                                                                                Atlas explains the app, never your notes.
                                                                                                                                
              
                                                                                                                                
                
                                                                                                                                
                  Atlas is named for a book of maps: the reference you open to

                                                                                                                                Tessellate
                                                                                                                                
              
                                                                                                                                
                A 100% offline, local-first notebook where a local AI files your
                thoughts and answers questions about them. Your data never leaves
                this computer.
              
                                                                                                                                
              
                                                                                                                                Tessellate for short. Formerly MemoryMap AI.
                                                                                                                                
              
                                                                                                                                
              
                                                                                                                                Free software, licensed under the GNU Affero General Public License v3.
                Source and releases on GitHub.
                                                                                                                                              
              
                                                                                                                                
              
              
                                                                                                                                
                
                
                Some changes, an installed extra, a switched model backend, only take effect after a restart.
              
                                                                                                                                
              
              
                                                                                                                                
                
                Opens in its own window, with its own icon.
                
              
                                                                                                                                
              
                                                                                                                                
                
                                                                                                                                
                  Installing gives Tessellate its own window and icon, and puts
                  it in your phone's share sheet, so a page or a selection
                  shared to it lands in Capture. It is the same app, still
                  served by the copy running on this computer: when that is
                  not running, the installed app says so rather than showing
                  an empty notebook. On an iPhone, tap Share, then Add to
                  Home Screen.
                
                                                                                                                                
              
                                                                                                                                
            
                                                                                                                                

            
            
                                                                                                                                
              
                                                                                                                                Health
                                                                                                                                
              
                                                                                                                                How the notebook is, each line with when it was true.
                                                                                                                                
              
                                                                                                                                
                
                                                                                                                                
                  Last backup
                  The newest copy of the notebook, and when it was taken.
                
                                                                                                                                
                , 
              
                                                                                                                                
              
                                                                                                                                
                
                                                                                                                                
                  Data folder
                  Everything this notebook keeps on disk, in total.
                
                                                                                                                                
                , 
              
                                                                                                                                
              
                                                                                                                                
                
                                                                                                                                
                  Integrity
                  The database checks itself, and the search index is counted beside your notes.
                
                                                                                                                                
                
                  
                  Not checked yet
                
              
                                                                                                                                
              
                                                                                                                                
                
                                                                                                                                
                  Database
                  Size on disk, and where this notebook's data lives.
                
                                                                                                                                
                , 
              
                                                                                                                                
              
                                                                                                                                
                
                                                                                                                                
                  Files on disk
                  Where the space goes: the notebook, attached files, pictures, backups and optional features.
                
                                                                                                                                
                
                                                                                                                                
                  
                                                                                                                                
                  
                                                                                                                                  
                
                                                                                                                                  
              
                                                                                                                                  
              
                                                                                                                                  
                
                                                                                                                                  
                  Notes, documents & files
                  What's actually stored in this notebook right now.
                
                                                                                                                                  
                , 
              
                                                                                                                                  
              
                                                                                                                                  
                
                                                                                                                                  
                  Background jobs
                  Whatever a re-index, a model download or the embedder is doing right now.
                
                                                                                                                                  
                , 
              
                                                                                                                                  
              
              
                                                                                                                                  
                
                                                                                                                                  
                  Search index
                  What the search can see, per kind, and whether the meaning-based half is loaded yet.
                
                                                                                                                                  
                , 
              
                                                                                                                                  
              
                                                                                                                                  
                
                                                                                                                                  
                  Model latency
                  How long each kind of job has been taking on this machine, the median and the slow end, from the last forty finished jobs.
                
                                                                                                                                  
                , 
              
                                                                                                                                  
              
                                                                                                                                  
                
                                                                                                                                  
                  Last error
                  The most recent warning or error in the app log, the full log is in Settings → Logs.
                
                                                                                                                                  
                , 
              
                                                                                                                                  
            
                                                                                                                                  

            
            
                                                                                                                                  
              
                                                                                                                                  
                
                                                                                                                                  Maintenance
                                                                                                                                  
                
              
                                                                                                                                  
              
                                                                                                                                  The launcher's checks and repairs, run on this computer.
                                                                                                                                  
              
                                                                                                                                  
                
                                                                                                                                  
                  Check this computer runs the checks doctor.sh and doctor.bat
                  print (start --doctor): Python, free disk, the port, the
                  model server, the notes folder and the last launch, plus
                  the search model and other devices, each with what to do.
                
                                                                                                                                  
                
                                                                                                                                  
                  Reinstall on next start rebuilds the app's Python
                  environment the next time start.sh or start.bat opens the
                  app, the same as reinstall.sh. Your notes, settings and
                  models are not touched. A copy from the installer has no
                  environment to rebuild; its Repair shortcut is the way.
                
                                                                                                                                  
                
                                                                                                                                  
                  Uninstall is never one click: it shows the steps and the
                  command for this computer, and Export my notes first.
                
                                                                                                                                  
              
                                                                                                                                  
              
                                                                                                                                  
                
                
                
                
                
              
                                                                                                                                  
              
                                                                                                                                  
                Set: the next start rebuilds the app's Python environment. Your notes are not touched.
                
                
              
                                                                                                                                  
              
                                                                                                                                  
              
                                                                                                                                  
            
                                                                                                                                  

            
                                                                                                                                  
              
                                                                                                                                  Updates
                                                                                                                                  
              
              
                                                                                                                                  Finding new versions
                                                                                                                                  
              
              
                                                                                                                                  
                
                
                
                
              
                                                                                                                                  
              
              
                                                                                                                                  Installing them
                                                                                                                                  
              
              
              
              
              
              
                                                                                                                                  
                
                                                                                                                                  
                  Off is the safer choice: you get versions that were finished
                  and tested.
                
                                                                                                                                  
                
              
                                                                                                                                  
              
                                                                                                                                  
                
                                                                                                                                  
                  Finished releases (off, the default): a
                  version that has been given a number, built and tested, the
                  way any app you install updates. A few a month at most, and
                  each one says what changed.
                
                                                                                                                                  
                
                                                                                                                                  
                  The newest changes (on): the code as it is
                  being written, day by day. New things reach you sooner, and
                  so do the mistakes in them. Worth it if you like being early
                  or you are reporting bugs.
                
                                                                                                                                  
                
                                                                                                                                  
                  Beta versions are finished candidates that
                  come before a release. With the beta switch on, a check
                  offers the highest version, a beta included. It is off by
                  default, and a final release always outranks its own betas.
                
                                                                                                                                  
                
                                                                                                                                  
                  Which one you can actually use depends on how this copy was
                  installed. A copy started by start.bat or start.sh can
                  follow the newest changes, because it pulls them from GitHub
                  itself at launch (the main branch) once you have said yes to
                  checking automatically; the first start asks that once. The packaged app
                  has no way to do that, so it always installs releases, and
                  this switch changes nothing for it.
                
                                                                                                                                  
              
                                                                                                                                  
              
              
                                                                                                                                  
                
                
                
              
                                                                                                                                  
              
              
              
              
                                                                                                                                  
                On by default. Turn it off for "User view", the app runs with
                no console window at all, just this app window and a system
                tray icon. You can also switch live from the tray icon's own
                menu, which remembers your choice for next time too, and the
                app briefly restarts itself when you switch this way.
              
                                                                                                                                  
              
              
              
                                                                                                                                  
                With this on, the X button hides the window and the app keeps
                running behind the tray icon, click it to bring the window
                back, or right-click → Quit to close it properly (which also
                stops any background work). With it off, closing the window
                quits.
              
                                                                                                                                  
              
              
                                                                                                                                  
                Advanced
                
                
                                                                                                                                  Off: launching again brings the open window forward. On: each launch opens another window onto the same running app.
