                                                                                                                                     Keyboard shortcuts
                                                                                                                                    
        
          
        
      
                                                                                                                                    
      
                                                                                                                                    Press a shortcut's keys, marked with a pencil, then the keys you want.
                                                                                                                                    
      
                                                                                                                                      
      
                                                                                                                                      
      
                                                                                                                                      
        
      
                                                                                                                                      

      
                                                                                                                                      
        
                                                                                                                                      Always available
                                                                                                                                      
        
      
                                                                                                                                      
      
                                                                                                                                      These aren't rebindable, the same in every app.
                                                                                                                                      
      
                                                                                                                                      
        
                                                                                                                                      
          These follow the conventions every app shares, so they aren't
          rebindable: being unable to press Escape in the dialog you rebound it
          in is not a state worth allowing.
        
                                                                                                                                      
      
                                                                                                                                      
      
                                                                                                                                        
        
                                                                                                                                      • EscClose any dialog, menu, or overlay
                                                                                                                                        • 
        
                                                                                                                                      • ← →Move between tabs (when a tab is focused)
                                                                                                                                        • 
        
                                                                                                                                      • ← →Move between a formatting toolbar's buttons (Tab reaches the toolbar once)
                                                                                                                                        • 
        
                                                                                                                                      • EnterSend a chat message, or run the selected command
                                                                                                                                        • 
        
                                                                                                                                      • TabMove focus; cycles inside an open dialog
                                                                                                                                        • 
        
                                                                                                                                      • t then d/n/c/g/l/i/rJump to Dashboard / Notes / Chat / Graph / Library / Timeline / Reminders
                                                                                                                                        • 
        
                                                                                                                                      • t then s/q/vOpen settings / a quick sketch / record a meeting
                                                                                                                                        • 
      
                                                                                                                                      
      
                                                                                                                                      Tools
                                                                                                                                      
      
                                                                                                                                      Small panels that open over what you are doing. Ctrl+K finds each by name.
                                                                                                                                      
      
      
                                                                                                                                        
      
                                                                                                                                        In the documents editor
                                                                                                                                        
      
                                                                                                                                        These work while you are writing in a document.
                                                                                                                                        
      
      
                                                                                                                                          
      
                                                                                                                                          
        Open a document once and these appear here.
      
                                                                                                                                          
      
                                                                                                                                          On a whiteboard
                                                                                                                                          
      
                                                                                                                                          These work while a board is open; the command palette lists every board action.
                                                                                                                                          
      
      
                                                                                                                                            
      
                                                                                                                                            
        Open a board once and these appear here.
      
                                                                                                                                            
      
                                                                                                                                            Tip: most actions also live in the command palette.
                                                                                                                                            
    
                                                                                                                                            
  
                                                                                                                                            

  
  
                                                                                                                                            
    
                                                                                                                                            
      
                                                                                                                                            
        
                                                                                                                                             Keys and controls
                                                                                                                                            
        
          
          
        
      
                                                                                                                                            
      
                                                                                                                                            
        
                                                                                                                                            A board is a note you can draw on. Drop notes in from the Library, sketch, write in shapes and connect things: a connector follows whatever it joins, even rotated, and everything on the board stays searchable.
                                                                                                                                            
        
                                                                                                                                            Paste or drop an image straight onto the board. Right-click anything (or hold it on a touch screen) for its menu, and Ctrl+K finds any board action by its name.
                                                                                                                                            
        
                                                                                                                                            The top bar, left to right: Boards (back to the board list), which board or map to show, find a card on this board, board overview, the Edit menu (undo, select, duplicate, delete), View (how the board looks and which panels are open), Board (export, clear, help), the sidebar: shapes, icons and frames, your notes, and the layers, and toggle full screen; on a phone, More board commands holds the rest. A selected topic: + (add a child topic), the bookmark (add a child that points at a note, document, file or link), its corner square (resize this topic; Shift scales the words), and the chevron is collapse this branch or expand this branch.
                                                                                                                                            
      
                                                                                                                                            
      
                                                                                                                                            Every key and gesture on a board. Ctrl+K finds any action by name.

Try a word like zoom, group or lock.

                                                                                                                                             Meeting notesVoice note
                                                                                                                                            
        
        
          
        
      
                                                                                                                                            
      
                                                                                                                                            Record a meeting or a lecture, saved as you go.A voice memo, kept in Library, Recordings.
                                                                                                                                            
      
                                                                                                                                            
        
                                                                                                                                            
          A meeting, a lecture, or anything the mic button in the composer is
          too short for. The audio is saved as you record, every 10 seconds,
          and kept in Library, Recordings whatever happens next. With the
          Voice notes add-on Whisper transcribes it on this machine; without
          it the recording is kept and the sheet says how long it is.
        
                                                                                                                                            
        
                                                                                                                                            
          Microphone, under the name, chooses the input and switches the
          browser's noise suppression, echo cancellation and automatic gain;
          Test records three seconds and plays them back (the same controls
          are in Settings, General), and Enhance on save cuts low rumble and
          evens the loudness of the kept audio, keeping the original until the
          transcript is saved. With the captions helper the words appear under
          the level line as you speak; the full transcript replaces them after.
          Live captions, before you record, writes what is said without
          recording it. Close this while recording and it keeps recording in a small bar at
          the bottom with the clock, Pause, Stop and Open; Discard throws the
          take away. Transcribing runs in the background: close this and a
          notification says when it is done, with Open; Stop transcribing ends
          it. The transcript comes back for you to read and trim before anything is
          saved. Saved, this shows its first lines with Open. It is a meeting note with the transcript under Notes, or,
          opened from a meeting's Record into it, it goes under that meeting's
          Notes. An hour of talking can be a document instead.
